description:
List curated ABS, RBA, and APRA catalogue entries, optionally filtered by source,
category, or tag. Unranked complement to search_datasets.

category.description: Optional curated catalogue or semantic concept category filter.

include_ceased.description: Whether to include ceased ABS catalogue entries.

include_discontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued RBA catalogue entries.

source.description: Optional source filter: abs (Australian Bureau of Statistics), rba (Reserve Bank of Australia) or apra (Australian Prudential Regulation Authority).

name: list_catalogue

outputSchema.description: Curated ABS, RBA, and APRA catalogue entries.

result.description: Curated ABS, RBA, and APRA catalogue entries.

title: List Catalogue
